shop.name: Sweet Crumbs Bakery
shop.policies: No refunds on custom cakes. Orders can be changed up to 12 hours before delivery.

faqs.question: Delivery charges?
faqs.answer: Delivery is Rs 200 in Gulshan-e-Iqbal, Gulistan-e-Johar, DHA, Clifton and PECHS.

faqs.question: Which areas do you deliver to?
faqs.answer: Gulshan-e-Iqbal, Gulistan-e-Johar, DHA, Clifton and PECHS.

faqs.question: How early should I order a cake?
faqs.answer: Please order cakes at least 1 day in advance.

faqs.question: Payment methods?
faqs.answer: Cash on delivery, JazzCash, Easypaisa or bank transfer.

faqs.question: Can you write a name on the cake?
faqs.answer: Yes, name or short message on the cake is free.

faqs.question: Do you make eggless cakes?
faqs.answer: Yes, eggless is available for Rs 300 extra with 2 days notice.

faqs.question: Refund policy?
faqs.answer: No refunds on custom cakes. Orders can be changed up to 12 hours before delivery.
